segments.comment: A gnomish Healer pies her own face, applies her stethoscope to herself, then puts on a blindfold and listens again. insight.c ustatusline() appends ", blind", then ", cover" only when the goop is not the sole blinder, then "ed by sticky goop": first "blinded by sticky goop", then "blind, covered by sticky goop". Seed, date and character chosen independently of the batch 14 pilot.
